scope: every sense authored in tick 3 (shard 12), drawn complete rather than sampled
authoring: parallel family-author agents, one per family, Opus 5 at xhigh, rubric taken verbatim from .claude/agents/family-author.md
reading_note: rubric taken verbatim from .claude/agents/census-reader.md - no re-typing, no added sections. Census 005's rate was withdrawn for exactly that.

entries.definition: not giving performances; closed
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: States a closure as a plain condition — nothing is being put on — where *dead* would make the emptiness itself the verdict.
examples: the theater is dark on Mondays

entries.definition: devoid of activity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The absolute form: activity is not merely reduced but gone, which is what carries it past *dull*.
examples: this is a dead town: nothing ever happens here

entries.definition: (of business) not active or brisk
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Hears the lack of briskness as a flatness worth complaining about, where *slow* only reports the rate.

entries.definition: not in active use
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts a hint of waste on the disuse — something capable of working and sitting there instead — which *unused* does not.
examples: the machinery sat idle during the strike

entries.definition: lacking activity; lying idle or unused
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The flat, unmarked term for the state, reporting that nothing is going on without suggesting anything is wrong with that.

entries.definition: (of business) not active or brisk
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The mildest of the three, measuring the pace of trade rather than passing judgement on it as *sluggish* does.

entries.definition: (of business) not active or brisk
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Adds torpor to the slackness, making the absence of brisk trade sound like something too heavy to move.

entries.definition: closed or immobilized by a strike
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Names the cause along with the standstill, so it attributes rather than evaluates the stoppage.

entries.definition: not in active use
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely factual: it records that the thing is not in use and stops, with none of the reproach in *idle*.

entries.definition: having life or vigor or spirit
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise cut back to a bare condition - where *animated* shows the vigor off, this only asserts that it is there.

entries.definition: having life or vigor or spirit
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Mild approval - credits a thing with visible vigor without claiming it brims over the way *lively* does.
examples: became very animated when he heard the good news

entries.definition: made lively or spirited
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Flat and causal - the liveliness was put in from outside, so the word credits the doing rather than the thing.
examples: a meal enlivened by the music

entries.definition: full of spirit; full of life
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A step past *animated*'s mere possession of spirit to fullness of it, and the warmth rises with the quantity.

entries.definition: given fresh life or vigor or spirit
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: States the restoration plainly - fresh vigor recorded as an outcome, with none of the relief *revived* carries.

entries.definition: given fresh life or vigor or spirit
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warmer than *reanimated* for the same return of vigor - the fresh life sounds like a recovery worth welcoming.

entries.definition: made lively or spirited
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Frankly admiring where *enlivened* stays descriptive - the same imparted liveliness heard as a virtue rather than an effect.

entries.definition: full of spirit; full of life
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Elevated in register - the same fullness of life as *lively*, but weightier, sounding like a force within rather than a liveliness on show.

entries.definition: marked by practical hardheaded intelligence
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise for judgement that sees through a situation, formal in register and weightier than *sharp*, which credits speed instead.
examples: an astute tenant always reads the small print in a lease

entries.definition: showing self-interest and shrewdness in dealing with others
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Credits the shrewdness while flagging the guardedness - intelligence held close and used defensively, which is why the approval is only half given.

entries.definition: showing self-interest and shrewdness in dealing with others
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: An alternate spelling carrying exactly the force of *cagey*, wariness and self-interest both.

entries.definition: showing self-interest and shrewdness in dealing with others
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Makes the self-interest sound like sound sense rather than concealment, warming what *cagey* leaves guarded.

entries.definition: showing self-interest and shrewdness in dealing with others
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The double-edged member - it grants the quickness while letting the self-interest show, so it can compliment and needle in one word.

entries.definition: marked by practical hardheaded intelligence
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same practical intelligence as *astute*, but felt as quickness and edge rather than depth.

entries.definition: marked by practical hardheaded intelligence
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approves the hardheaded part out loud, so the compliment comes with a coolness *astute* does not have.
examples: he was too shrewd to go along with them on a road that could lead only to their overthrow

entries.definition: showing mental alertness and calculation and resourcefulness
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The family's plain approving term - alertness and resourcefulness credited straight, with none of the self-interested edge *cagey* carries.

entries.definition: having the shrewd resourcefulness needed to survive in an urban environment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Says what *streetwise* says with the parts laid bare, the street and the smartness named separately, which makes it land blunter.

entries.definition: having the shrewd resourcefulness needed to survive in an urban environment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Respect for intelligence proved under pressure rather than taught - resourcefulness measured by whether it keeps a person going in a city.

entries.definition: having the shrewd resourcefulness needed to survive in an urban environment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Informal and light, it makes the same survival-sharpness sound like being clued in rather than hardened by it.

entries.definition: constructing or tending to construct or improve or promote development
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving on two counts at once - it builds and it improves, where *formative* only shapes and leaves the worth of the result open.

entries.definition: promoting construction or creation
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving at one remove: it credits what fosters making rather than the making itself, a lighter claim than the improvement built into *constructive*.

entries.definition: forming or capable of forming or molding or fashioning
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral - it names the power to shape without saying the shaping is for the better, which is exactly what *constructive* asserts.

entries.definition: based on interpretation; not directly expressed
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Carries no approval at all - it marks how something is arrived at, by interpretation rather than statement, where *constructive* judges the worth of what is done.

entries.definition: forming or capable of forming or molding or fashioning
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Treats the power to mold as a flat property of a thing rather than a merit, which keeps it cooler than *creative*.

entries.definition: helping to restore to good condition
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving of repair: the good it names is a return to sound condition rather than the new making in *constructive*.

entries.definition: helping to restore to good condition
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same restoring good as *reconstructive*, but the longer, more formal word makes the helping sound like a sustained process rather than a single fix.

entries.definition: forming or capable of forming or molding or fashioning
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Bare and unweighted, the act of forming stated as such, where *formative* points instead at the capacity to form.

entries.definition: concerned with systematic structure in a particular field of study
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely descriptive - it places a thing within a system of study and does none of the approving that runs through *constructive*.

entries.definition: of an earlier date
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely positional - it sets something at an earlier date and judges nothing about it.

entries.definition: no longer having force or relevance
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt and absolute - force and relevance are gone outright, not ebbing as in *obsolescent*.

entries.definition: no longer in use
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: States the plain fact of non-use and leaves the reason alone.

entries.definition: not current or belonging to the present time
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The flattest term here - a bare negation of present-day standing, without the verdict *obsolete* passes.

entries.definition: becoming obsolete
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Marks the slide rather than the arrival - on its way to what *obsolete* already is.

entries.definition: no longer in use
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The same non-use as *disused*, but delivered as a verdict rather than an observation.

entries.definition: old; no longer valid or fashionable
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Plain and unemphatic - it reports the same lapse *outdated* reports, with less of the reproach.

entries.definition: old; no longer valid or fashionable
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Faults the thing for its age, withdrawing validity and fashion in one stroke.

entries.definition: old; no longer valid or fashionable
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal and faintly withering - age is treated as having disqualified the thing.

entries.definition: damaged by blows or hard usage
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the cause inside the word - blows and hard usage - where *damaged* leaves the cause blank.

entries.definition: damaged by blows or hard usage
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal where *battered* is neutral in register, treating the same hard usage as something to shrug at rather than record.

entries.definition: damaged by blows or hard usage
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The fuller form of *beat-up*, equally informal, with a little more of the beating still audible in it.

entries.definition: in deplorable condition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Wears the deplorable condition on the surface, making it look pitiable rather than shameful, where *derelict* makes it a reproach.

entries.definition: of metal e.g.
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Damage as deformation rather than breakage: the shape has gone but not necessarily the use, which *broken* denies outright.

entries.definition: in deplorable condition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names the deplorable state as something that has given way, plainer and more mechanical than *tatterdemalion*.

entries.definition: out of working order (‘busted’ is an informal substitute for ‘broken’)
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A verdict on function alone: the thing does not work, and the word says nothing about how it got there, where *battered* says little else.

entries.definition: out of working order (‘busted’ is an informal substitute for ‘broken’)
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The informal substitute for *broken*, and the drop in register makes the same failure sound offhand rather than serious.

entries.definition: of metal e.g.
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Deformation taken across the whole of a thing rather than along one line, so it reads as more thorough than *bent* while judging just as little.
examples: a car with a crumpled front end

entries.definition: harmed or injured or spoiled
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The family's flat baseline: harm has occurred, and the word passes no verdict on the state it left, where *dilapidated* passes little else.
examples: the storm left a wake of badly damaged buildings

entries.definition: of metal e.g.
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The most local of these three - one blow's worth of deformation, where *crumpled* takes the whole surface.

entries.definition: in deplorable condition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Condemning rather than descriptive - the deplorable state reads as neglect that was allowed to happen, where *dented* is only a fact about a shape.

entries.definition: in deplorable condition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The formal word for the deplorable state, presenting it as advanced and cumulative decay rather than the single mishap *dented* records.

entries.definition: in deplorable condition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Adds precariousness to the deplorable state - the thing is not merely poor but barely holding together, which *damaged* never implies.

entries.definition: in deplorable condition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most ornate word in this set, and the flourish makes the contempt sound almost relished beside plain *broken-down*.

entries.definition: in deplorable condition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Plain-spoken where *tatterdemalion* is ornate, and it leaves the deplorable state one shove from collapse.

entries.definition: ludicrously odd
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Odd to the point of being laughed at - the strangeness reads as clownish rather than menacing.

entries.definition: bizarre or fantastic
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt and informal - it throws up its hands at the strangeness instead of examining it.

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The oddness is inviting - it asks to be looked into, where *queer* asks to be backed away from.

entries.definition: inspiring a feeling of fear; strange and frightening
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The strangeness has turned frightening - it works on the nerves rather than on the judgement.
examples: an uncomfortable and eerie stillness in the woods

entries.definition: ludicrously odd
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Oddness inflated past what belief will carry, so the extravagance itself is the fault.

entries.definition: ludicrously odd
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The more elaborate twin of *fantastic* - the oddness sounds invented rather than merely met with.

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Marks something as not quite right without saying what is wrong with it, and the vagueness is the unease.
examples: her speech has a funny twang
they have some funny ideas about war

entries.definition: ludicrously odd
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The harshest of these - the oddness is distorted enough to repel, where *antic* only invites laughter.
examples: a grotesque reflection in the mirror

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plain workhorse of this set - it registers the deviation flatly, with none of *peculiar*'s second look.

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Fastens the oddness onto the thing itself, as a quality it owns rather than an impression it gives.
examples: the peculiar aromatic odor of cloves

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Adds a wariness *odd* lacks - the deviation feels wrong rather than merely noticeable.
examples: something definitely queer about this town

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Informal and offhand - the oddness gets a shrug rather than a verdict.

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A lighter, more throwaway ring than *rum*, the same shrug loosened further.

entries.definition: beyond or deviating from the usual or expected
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The one word here that flatters - deviation read as standing apart rather than as going wrong.

entries.definition: being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Carries a faint edge of unease that *unusual* does not - what is strange is not merely rare but slightly off.
examples: a strange exaltation that was indefinable
what a strange sense of humor she has

entries.definition: being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The flat member of the pair - it records a departure from the expected without *strange*'s hint that something is amiss.

entries.definition: of stone or timber; shaped roughly without finishing
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flatter and more matter-of-fact than *roughhewn*, naming the cut alone without that word's suggestion of ruggedly worked bulk.

entries.definition: of stone or timber; shaped roughly without finishing
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral about workmanship - the shaping has been done and only the finishing has not, where *unhewn* denies the shaping altogether.

entries.definition: of lumber or stone or hides; not finished or dressed
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Names one specific operation left undone rather than a general falling-short, which keeps it cooler and more technical than *unfinished*.

entries.definition: (of market animals) not optimal for marketing
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Coolly commercial disparagement - the animal is graded short of what the market wants, a deficiency stated as plain fact rather than complaint.

entries.definition: not brought to the desired final state
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Carries a faint reproach because the thing is measured against the final state that was wanted, so it records a shortfall rather than merely a stage.

entries.definition: (of stone especially) not given a finished form by or as if by hewing
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Denies the shaping outright where *roughhewn* concedes a first pass, and its as-if reach lets it settle on things no tool was ever near.
examples: a house of unhewn grey stone roughly cemented together

entries.definition: profoundly honored
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Lofty and formal - it raises the honor so high it puts distance between subject and speaker, where *honorable* stays level with you.

entries.definition: worthy of being honored; entitled to honor and respect
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain claim of the family - it certifies that respect is deserved, without the awe *august* and *venerable* pile on top.

entries.definition: worthy of being honored; entitled to honor and respect
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The British spelling, carrying exactly the same entitlement to respect as *honorable* with nothing added or softened.

entries.definition: worthy of the greatest honor or distinction
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Superlative - it does not merely grant honor but sets its object at the summit of it, where *honorable* only confirms the desert.
examples: The nation's pediatrician laureate is preparing to lay down his black bag

entries.definition: profoundly honored
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Locates the honor in those who feel it - the regard is actively given, not merely owed as with *honorable*.

entries.definition: honored because of age or long usage
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approval with its grounds stated - the honor is credited to having lasted, where *honorable* and *venerable* name the honor without saying what earned it.

entries.definition: honored because of age or long usage
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The British spelling, endorsing a thing for its endurance in precisely the terms *time-honored* uses.

entries.definition: profoundly honored
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Solemn - it wraps the honor in a hush of reverence rather than the ceremonial elevation of *august*.

entries.definition: inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Unguarded warmth, all wonder and no weight, where *awe-inspiring* holds the same admiration at arm's length.
examples: New York is an amazing city

entries.definition: commanding attention
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Attention is seized and held - it stops you mid-stride, where *impressive* only invites you to admire at your leisure.
examples: an arresting drawing of people turning into animals

entries.definition: so surprisingly impressive as to stun or overwhelm
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Surprise is the mechanism here: it overwhelms because it exceeds what you were braced for, not because it is merely large.
examples: such an enormous response was astonishing

entries.definition: so surprisingly impressive as to stun or overwhelm
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A heavier landing than *astonishing* - the surprise does not just register, it takes the ground out from under.

entries.definition: inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal, and it names the effect instead of voicing it - it reports what a thing does to an onlooker where *amazing* simply exclaims.
examples: the Grand Canyon is an awe-inspiring sight

entries.definition: inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The speaker's enthusiasm is as much on display as the thing admired, which is what makes it praise rather than description.
examples: the awesome complexity of the universe

entries.definition: inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Sits at the awe end of this sense - the impression overpowers rather than pleases, which is the whole distance between it and *amazing*.
examples: this sea, whose gently awful stirrings seem to speak of some hidden soul beneath

entries.definition: inspiring awe or admiration or wonder
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A flat participle that states the effect and stops, carrying none of the speaker's own delight that *awesome* puts on show.
examples: Westminster Hall's awing majesty, so vast, so high, so silent

entries.definition: impressive in size, manner, or appearance
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Grandeur with rank in it - the scale reads as lordly, claiming consequence rather than just filling space.

entries.definition: impressive in size, manner, or appearance
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Impressiveness that presses down on the onlooker, commanding respect from a slight distance and closer to daunting than to inviting.

entries.definition: making a strong or vivid impression
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The family's plain measure of approval - something lands strongly, with none of the claim to flatten you that *staggering* makes.

entries.definition: impressive in size, manner, or appearance
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The bulk or bearing reads as dignity, an elevation of quality, where *imposing* achieves its effect by weight alone.
examples: severe-looking policemen sat astride noble horses

entries.definition: commanding attention
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The notice is commanded by sheer display, so the attention feels taken rather than deserved.
examples: a sensational concert — one never to be forgotten

entries.definition: so surprisingly impressive as to stun or overwhelm
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The overwhelm is bodily - it arrives as weight and puts you off balance, where *astonishing* works on the expectations instead.
examples: the amount of money required was staggering

entries.definition: commanding attention
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Commands attention by knocking it loose - the looking is involuntary, not the considered halt of *arresting*.

entries.definition: so surprisingly impressive as to stun or overwhelm
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The stun taken to its blank end, where the mind goes slack rather than sharp, so the admiration comes dulled.
examples: the figure inside the boucle dress was stupefying

entries.definition: acceptable to your conscience
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The bar it sets is internal and low - the thing clears your conscience rather than being right in itself, so it approves far more faintly than *fitting*.

entries.definition: being precisely fitting and right
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approval by exactness rather than permission - not merely allowable but precisely right, and it says so plainly where *meet* pronounces.

entries.definition: being precisely fitting and right
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same verdict as *fitting* delivered as a formal pronouncement, weighty and a little ceremonious, so the rightness sounds handed down rather than observed.
examples: it is only meet that she should be seated first

entries.definition: given or inflicted in requital according to merits or deserts
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Cool and measured - what it approves is the fit between deserts and what is dealt out, not whatever it lands on, and it never softens the fact that the thing is inflicted.

entries.definition: given or inflicted in requital according to merits or deserts
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Carries the same verdict as *retributive* with more machinery in the mouth, sounding like the working of paying back rather than the principle behind it.

entries.definition: legally valid
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approval of the coldest kind - a warrant rather than a compliment, resting on validity where *conscionable* rests on conscience.

entries.definition: given or inflicted in requital according to merits or deserts
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Points at the rightness rather than the sting - where *retributive* names the paying back, this frames the same act as a claim made good.

entries.definition: in danger of the eternal punishment of Hell
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Lays the peril on the subject from outside, as something worked upon them, where *unsaved* reports only a lack.

entries.definition: in danger of the eternal punishment of Hell
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The verdict pronounced outright, naming the punishment rather than circling it - heavier than *doomed*, which only fixes the outcome.

entries.definition: destroyed physically or morally
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Absolute - the wreck, physical or moral, is already complete, where *doomed* leaves it still ahead.

entries.definition: in danger of the eternal punishment of Hell
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Settles the peril as fate already fixed, condemning without a condemner, where *cursed* implies something laid it on.

entries.definition: spiritually or physically doomed or destroyed
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The softest of these condemnations - it states the doom as a settled condition without naming who or what condemned, where *damned* pronounces the sentence.

entries.definition: destroyed physically or morally
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Keeps the aftermath in view, something once whole now spoiled, a shade less final than *destroyed*.

entries.definition: in danger of the eternal punishment of Hell
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal and abstract - an account left unsettled rather than a sentence passed, so it lands well short of *damned*.

entries.definition: in danger of the eternal punishment of Hell
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flattest way to state the danger, a bare absence of rescue where *damned* is an active condemnation.

entries.definition: arousing affect
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The barest of the three that share this sense — it reports that feeling was produced and stops there, where *poignant* and *touching* each put a force behind it.
examples: the homecoming of the released hostages was an affecting scene

entries.definition: having a deeply disquieting or disturbing effect
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The one member whose effect is unwelcome — it credits real depth while naming the disturbance, where *heartwarming* credits only the pleasure.
examples: from two handsome and talented young men to two haunting horrors of disintegration

entries.definition: causing gladness and pleasure
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Unmixed warmth — the only member that guarantees the feeling is a glad one, where *moving* leaves the kind of emotion open.
examples: Is there a sight more heartwarming than a family reunion?

entries.definition: arousing or capable of arousing deep emotion
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plainest full-strength term here — it credits depth of feeling without saying what the feeling is, where *heartwarming* and *haunting* each name its colour.
examples: she laid her case of destitution before him in a very moving letter

entries.definition: arousing affect
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The keenest of the three — the feeling it names arrives with an edge, where *touching* arrives softly.

entries.definition: exciting strong but not unpleasant emotions
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The emphatic form of the same sense — it puts the whole self behind the feeling *stirring* merely raises.

entries.definition: exciting strong but not unpleasant emotions
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Rousing rather than tender — it makes the emotion strong and forward-moving while ruling out the discomfort *haunting* trades in.

entries.definition: arousing affect
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The mildest of the three — a small stir of feeling rather than the keen pull *poignant* exerts.
examples: his gratitude was simple and touching

entries.definition: rendered motionless for lack of wind
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Carries its cause with it - the wind has failed, so the stillness is suffered rather than held, which plain *motionless* leaves open.

entries.definition: fixed and unmoving
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Stillness with something holding it there - not merely unmoving but pinned, which *still* never implies.
examples: with eyes set in a fixed glassy stare

entries.definition: absolutely still
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The stillness of a sudden stop - motion arrested mid-course rather than never begun, unlike *stationary*.

entries.definition: not in physical motion
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: On this sense it reports only that a thing is not physically moving, carrying none of the completeness of *motionless*.

entries.definition: unable to move or resist motion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names an incapacity rather than a state - the thing cannot move or push back, which *motionless* never claims.

entries.definition: not in physical motion
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Complete and picture-like - a body wholly without movement, where *inactive* merely records that none is occurring.
examples: She remained motionless, yet poised to take flight

entries.definition: not in motion
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The bare denial - it states only that motion is absent, with none of the held-in-place force of *fixed*.

entries.definition: fixed and unmoving
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Adds stiffness to the fixity - it does not move because it will not bend, where *fixed* says only that it is held.

entries.definition: absolutely still
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Stillness as being held fast from below - immovable rather than simply halted like *frozen*.

entries.definition: fixed and unmoving
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Blunter and more settled than *fixed*, suggesting a position taken and no longer open to adjustment.
examples: with eyes set in a fixed glassy stare
his bearded face already has a set hollow look

entries.definition: not moving and therefore easy to attack
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Stillness read as exposure - it puts a target on whatever it describes, which no other member of the family does.

entries.definition: not in physical motion
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Cool and near-technical, framing stillness as a standing condition of the thing rather than a moment of it as *motionless* does.

entries.definition: standing still
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral and positional - stillness as where a thing stands, not something done to it as in *becalmed*.
examples: the car remained stationary with the engine running

entries.definition: not in physical motion
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plainest and calmest member - stillness as quiet, not as the arrest that *frozen* implies.

entries.definition: absolutely still
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The most emphatic way to say it - total, unqualified stillness, without the sense of arrest in *frozen*.

entries.definition: not in motion
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: More observational than *nonmoving*, describing a thing seen not to move rather than classifying it as one that does not.

entries.definition: (of weather) highly enjoyable
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Turned on the weather, it rates a day at the top of enjoyable rather than merely *pleasant*.

entries.definition: extremely pleasant in a gentle way
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Intensity turned soft — pleasantness taken to an extreme, but gently, where *gratifying* is emphatic.
examples: the most dulcet swimming on the most beautiful and remote beaches

entries.definition: affording satisfaction or pleasure
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Unadorned approval of something that gives pleasure, carrying none of the sense of a want answered that *gratifying* adds.

entries.definition: affording comfort or pleasure
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Describes the thing that gives comfort rather than the person who feels thanks — a warm, easing approval beside the brighter *pleasurable*.
examples: the grateful warmth of the fire

entries.definition: affording satisfaction or pleasure
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Leans on the satisfaction half of the sense — pleasure that answers something, where *pleasurable* is pleasure for its own sake.

entries.definition: suggestive of an idyll; charmingly simple and serene
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The strongest here — not merely pleasant but charmed, simple and serene, an ideal rather than a preference met.

entries.definition: affording pleasure; being in harmony with your taste or likings
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain baseline of the family — pleasure that simply agrees with your taste, without the sweetness of *dulcet* or the height of *idyllic*.
examples: we had a pleasant evening together

entries.definition: pleasant or agreeable to the senses
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Routes approval through the senses — what strikes eye or ear as agreeable, milder than the extremity of *dulcet*.

entries.definition: affording satisfaction or pleasure
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most direct of these three: it names the pleasure itself, with none of the fulfilment *gratifying* implies.
examples: full of happiness and pleasurable excitement
good printing makes a book more pleasurable to read

entries.definition: guaranteed to bring a profit
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approves through certainty rather than size - the profit is treated as already secured, where *profitable* claims only that it is there.
examples: without bankable stars the film script aroused no interest

entries.definition: financially rewarding
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The dry member - it approves by the ledger, granting a reward without any of the appetite in *fat* or *juicy*.
examples: it was no longer economic to keep the factory open
have to keep prices high enough to make it economic to continue the service

entries.definition: lucrative
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Relish rather than accounting - it praises a return by its sheer thickness, where *profitable* merely records one.

entries.definition: yielding a fair profit
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Measured approval - the return it names is a fair one rather than a large one, which keeps it clear of the greed in *juicy*.

entries.definition: lucrative
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Appetite - it makes the profit tempting, something to be got at, where *fat* only makes it thick.

entries.definition: producing a sizeable profit
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and emphatic at once - the size of the profit is the entire claim, stated without the hunger of *juicy*.

entries.definition: producing a sizeable profit
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Blunt where *lucrative* is formal - it names the money outright and lets that stand as the praise.

entries.definition: yielding a fair profit
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The barest member - it marks that money came and makes no claim at all about whether that is much.

entries.definition: yielding a fair profit
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Mildly approving - it treats the return as something the thing keeps doing, where *paid* records only that it happened.

entries.definition: yielding material gain or profit
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The flat baseline of the family - it reports that a return exists and says nothing about its size or how welcome it is, which is the whole of what *juicy* adds.
examples: profitable speculation on the stock market

entries.definition: producing a sizeable profit
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most formal way to say it - it lends a sizeable profit a decorum that *moneymaking* makes no attempt at.

entries.definition: (used of cultures of microorganisms) completely free from other organisms
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Technical and exact: it certifies that a culture of microorganisms holds no other organism, a specification rather than a compliment.

entries.definition: free from impurities
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving in a plain, physical way — the impurities are gone, and it says so without the ceremony of *pristine*.

entries.definition: (of sound or color) free from anything that dulls or dims
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise for a sound or colour that nothing dulls or dims — the brightness is the point, not the absence of dirt that *clean* answers to.

entries.definition: free from impurities; having a high or specified degree of purity
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Gradable where the rest are absolute: purity here is a degree that can be high or specified, so it measures where *pure* merely declares.

entries.definition: free from impurities
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Names the same absence of impurity as *clean* but with a livelier, more inviting force.

entries.definition: (of sound or color) free from anything that dulls or dims
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Softer and less emphatic than *clear* for the same undulled sound or colour, approving without insisting.
examples: a light lilting voice like a silver bell

entries.definition: as found in nature in the elemental form
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Descriptive rather than evaluative — it records that the thing already stands in its elemental form in nature, and attaches no credit to that.

entries.definition: not mixed with extraneous elements
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The flattest word here, stating that nothing extraneous is mixed in and neither admiring nor disparaging the fact.

entries.definition: completely free from dirt or contamination
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The admiring extreme — not merely unmixed but wholly untouched by dirt or contamination, a completeness *clean* never claims.

entries.definition: free of extraneous elements of any kind
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The unrestricted term of the family — nothing extraneous of any kind survives it, where *clean* answers only to impurity.
examples: the violin's pure and lovely song

entries.definition: not mixed with extraneous elements
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Absolute in force where *plain* is merely factual, pressing on the totality of the unmixedness rather than reporting it.

entries.definition: (of an alcoholic drink) stirred or shaken with ice, but served without it
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A serving instruction rather than a judgement: the drink met the ice and was left without it, and the phrase passes no verdict on the result.
examples: I like my martinis straight up

entries.definition: made pure
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The opposite arrival from *native* — purity reached by being made, stated as a result rather than praised.

entries.definition: (of sound or color) free from anything that dulls or dims
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The negative form makes the dimness explicit, praising a sound or colour by naming what fails to cloud it where *clear* simply asserts the brightness.

entries.definition: not mixed with extraneous elements
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal and slightly stiff, denying admixture in so many words rather than asserting purity outright as *pure* does.

entries.definition: not mixed with extraneous elements
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The blunt, unceremonious form of that same denial — *unmingled* says it formally, this says it flatly.

entries.definition: deserving of esteem and respect
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The warmest word here - it does not merely permit respect but calls for it, wholehearted where *respectable* is guarded.

entries.definition: having an illustrious reputation; respected
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warm and elevating - the regard is felt rather than merely recorded, and pitched high enough to make the reputation an illustrious one.

entries.definition: deserving of esteem and respect
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal, and it turns on desert rather than receipt - the respect is owed whether or not anyone is paying it, unlike *respected*.

entries.definition: deserving of esteem and respect
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plainest carrier in the family - it grants the same desert as *estimable* with none of the elevation, approval stated flat.

entries.definition: deserving of esteem and respect
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Weights the desert toward conduct - respect a person has earned, where *prestigious* names respect that standing confers.

entries.definition: having an illustrious reputation; respected
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Frames the standing as a distinction conferred and marked, where *esteemed* leaves it as regard quietly held.

entries.definition: having an illustrious reputation; respected
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The British spelling of *honored*, identical in force and in the conferred distinction it implies.

entries.definition: having an illustrious reputation; respected
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Puts the weight on the shine of the name itself - impressiveness rather than the warmth *esteemed* carries toward the person holding it.

entries.definition: worthy of respect or honor
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and weighty, and the respect it claims keeps its distance - something closer to awe than to the warmth of *admirable*.

entries.definition: having a good reputation
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approval at its lowest setting - it certifies that a reputation is sound without claiming it is distinguished, which is exactly what *esteemed* claims.

entries.definition: deserving of esteem and respect
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise measured to the bar rather than to the height - it says the standard is met and stops well short of admiration.

entries.definition: receiving deferential regard
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Reports regard actually given rather than deserved - the mirror of *estimable*, which claims the desert and says nothing about receipt.

entries.definition: acceptable for a long time, or having a long history
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approves by duration rather than by merit - the warrant is how long a thing has been accepted, not whether it deserves to be.

entries.definition: acceptable for a long time, or having a long history
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The British spelling of *time-honored*, carrying the same dignity conferred by long standing.

entries.definition: receiving deferential regard
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain-spoken, understated form of *respected*: the same deference, named without ceremony.

entries.definition: cheerfully irresponsible
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most forgiving word here - the missing care reads as freedom from burden rather than neglect of duty.

entries.definition: cheerfully irresponsible
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Bravado rather than lightness - it flaunts the disregard where *carefree* simply has no worry to shed.

entries.definition: characterized by inability or unwillingness to work toward a goal or assume responsibility
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Flatly dismissive - it writes someone off by what they never get done, with no charm allowed into the failing.

entries.definition: not fit to assume responsibility
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A verdict of unfitness rather than a report of behaviour, and the most withering word in the set.

entries.definition: cheerfully irresponsible
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Motion with the brakes off - it approves the ease while leaving the absent check audible.

entries.definition: cheerfully irresponsible
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Indulgent - it credits a temperament rather than charging a fault.

entries.definition: cheerfully irresponsible
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Its jingling repetition makes the cheer sound scatterbrained, tipping into scolding where *happy-go-lucky* stays fond.

entries.definition: lacking a sense of restraint or responsibility
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A light word for the fault - what is missing is restraint, not any active wrongdoing.

entries.definition: showing lack of care for consequences
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plain charge the rest take their colour from - blame falls on the consequences left unweighed, with none of the cheer of *carefree*.

entries.definition: lacking a sense of restraint or responsibility
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Carries a moral edge *idle* does not - the restraint gone slack is the kind a person is expected to hold.

entries.definition: cheerfully irresponsible
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The cheer here undercuts the person as giddy and unfit to be trusted, where *carefree* leaves them intact.

entries.definition: irresponsible in the use of firearms
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The cheerful *-happy* ending set against carelessness with a gun is the whole sting of it.

entries.definition: free from control or responsibility
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Positional rather than evaluative - it states the absence of anyone to answer to, without judging the person for it.

entries.definition: lacking a sense of responsibility
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Judged from outside - where *irresponsible* looks at the consequences, this looks at whoever was depending.

entries.definition: highly skilled
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise with attainment behind it — skill brought to a high finish, warmer and more admiring than the flat *skilled*.

entries.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise for deft, unlaboured sureness — it admires the aptitude in the doing where *expert* admires the knowing.

entries.definition: highly skilled
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approves by totality rather than dazzle — it says nothing is missing from the skill, a cooler verdict than *accomplished*.

entries.definition: having or revealing supreme mastery or skill
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Superlative praise — skill carried to its finish with nothing left to add, far above the workaday *proficient*.

entries.definition: marked by great skill especially in meticulous technique
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise for fineness of touch — skill admired for precision and restraint rather than the power heard in *masterful*.

entries.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The authoritative member: it grants knowledge that can be leaned on and vouched for, weightier and less warm than *good*.

entries.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The mildest approval here — it concedes competence and stops, where *expert* confers standing.

entries.definition: having or revealing supreme mastery or skill
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise that hears authority in the skill — command of the craft, where *accomplished* only reports a high finish.

entries.definition: having or revealing supreme mastery or skill
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Admires mastery in the execution rather than in the person, the quieter of the pair beside *masterful*.
examples: a masterly performance of the sonata

entries.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Credits skill that has been worked in until it is habitual, steadier and less brilliant than *virtuoso*.

entries.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Measured, almost certifying approval — it reports that the standard is met, with none of the admiration in *masterful*.

entries.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The British spelling, carrying exactly the approving weight of *skillful* for deftness in execution.

entries.definition: having or showing or requiring special skill
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Plain, checkable praise — it credits capability without admiring it, and can sit on the work that demands the skill as easily as on the person who has it.
examples: only the most skilled gymnasts make an Olympic team
a skilled surgeon has many years of training and experience
a skilled reconstruction of her damaged elbow

entries.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approves the handling itself — visible dexterity in execution, more concrete than the standing implied by *expert*.
examples: a lesser-known but no less skillful composer
the effect was achieved by skillful retouching

entries.definition: having or revealing supreme mastery or skill
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise pitched at display — mastery brilliant enough to be watched, showier than the sober *consummate*.

entries.definition: very sophisticated especially because of surfeit; versed in the ways of the world
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The sophistication is charged to surfeit, which sours the praise - it marks a person as past being impressed where *worldly* only marks them as experienced.
examples: the blase traveler refers to the ocean he has crossed as ‘the pond’

entries.definition: possessing sound knowledge
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The approval is for sound knowledge itself, with none of the social finish *sophisticated* insists on.

entries.definition: showing a high degree of refinement and the assurance that comes from wide social experience
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise for the finish, where the assurance is the visible surface and *refined* names the quality under it.

entries.definition: showing a high degree of refinement and the assurance that comes from wide social experience
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Names the refinement itself rather than its display, so it praises without the suggestion of buffing that *polished* carries.

entries.definition: having or appealing to those having worldly knowledge and refinement and savoir-faire
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises worldly knowledge and refinement together, and it settles on the thing made for such a person as easily as on the person - a reach *urbane* lacks.

entries.definition: showing a high degree of refinement and the assurance that comes from wide social experience
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The formal member, putting the weight on assured ease of manner rather than the surface shine *polished* names.
examples: maintained an urbane tone in his letters

entries.definition: possessing sound knowledge
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Flatter than *intelligent* - the credit goes to what a person knows, not to anything in the knower.

entries.definition: experienced in and wise to the ways of the world
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises shrewdness rather than polish - it says a person cannot be fooled, which *urbane* never claims.

entries.definition: very sophisticated especially because of surfeit; versed in the ways of the world
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Takes the versed-in-the-ways-of-the-world half of the sense straight, crediting the experience without the taint of excess *blase* carries.
examples: the benefits of his worldly wisdom

entries.definition: tried unsuccessfully
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Marks the act as the thing that failed rather than the one who made it, which is where it parts from *defeated*.

entries.definition: disappointingly unsuccessful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Failure recast as a loss to something stronger, carrying the sting of being beaten that *unsuccessful* leaves out.

entries.definition: disappointingly unsuccessful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The softest of the blocked set - the failure sits in a hope let down rather than in any force that stopped it, unlike *thwarted*.

entries.definition: disappointingly unsuccessful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal, and it adds embarrassment to the failure: not merely beaten but put out of countenance.

entries.definition: doomed to extinction
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and final, a verdict pronounced with none of the room for recovery that *frustrated* still leaves open.

entries.definition: lacking resources (or any prospect of resources)
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Widens the failure to a whole condition, nothing held and nothing coming, with a bleakness *empty-handed* keeps at arm's length.

entries.definition: having acquired or gained nothing
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Concrete where *unrewarded* is abstract - it shows the nothing instead of naming it.
examples: they returned from the negotiations empty-handed

entries.definition: disappointingly unsuccessful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Sounds the note of a scheme blocked at the last moment, lighter and more gleeful than the grim *thwarted*.
examples: their foiled attempt to capture Calais

entries.definition: disappointingly unsuccessful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the weight on effort spent for nothing, so the failure feels drawn out rather than delivered in one blow like *defeated*.
examples: many frustrated poets end as pipe-smoking teachers

entries.definition: doomed to extinction
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Grave rather than colloquial: the ending is total and stated without relish, where *washed-up* sneers.

entries.definition: doomed to extinction
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt and informal, a one-syllable verdict that closes the matter faster than *ruined* does.

entries.definition: disappointingly unsuccessful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The hardest of the blocked set - something outside did the stopping, and the word gives that force a weight *foiled* does not.

entries.definition: doomed to extinction
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal and near-elegiac, treating the end as something that came apart rather than something that was smashed.

entries.definition: having acquired or gained nothing
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral and faintly on the subject's side, recording that nothing came of it without calling the effort wasted.

entries.definition: not successful; having failed or having an unfavorable outcome
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The flat baseline of the family - it records the unfavorable outcome and passes no verdict on whoever met it.

entries.definition: doomed to extinction
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most contemptuous of the doomed set - it dismisses as much as it describes, which *undone* never does.

entries.definition: (used of behavior or attitude) characteristic of those who treat others with condescension
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The lightest of the condescension words - superiority worn as a knowing manner rather than pressed on anyone, though it is still looking down.

entries.definition: (used of behavior or attitude) characteristic of those who treat others with condescension
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names the fault flatly: a manner that puts the other person below, without the play in *arch*.

entries.definition: standing above others in quality or position
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving - the height is in quality as much as position, where *high-ranking* only marks the rung.

entries.definition: at an elevated level in rank or importance
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral placement: it states elevation in rank or importance and passes no judgement on whoever occupies it.

entries.definition: at an elevated level in rank or importance
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Blunter than *eminent* - elevation as a plain fact of rank, with none of the lustre.

entries.definition: standing above others in quality or position
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The barest way to say the same standing - elevation without the honour *eminent* confers.

entries.definition: greatest in importance or degree or significance or achievement
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Puts the subject at the front of the field, and does it in a level, unceremonious voice beside *preeminent*.

entries.definition: majestic in manner or bearing; superior to mundane matters
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Awed rather than merely approving - the superiority sits in the bearing, and it lifts the subject clear of ordinary concerns.

entries.definition: majestic in manner or bearing; superior to mundane matters
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Cooler and more remote than *majestic* - the loftiness reads as untouched by mundane things rather than warmly grand.

entries.definition: (used of behavior or attitude) characteristic of those who treat others with condescension
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The British spelling of *patronizing*, and it gives up none of the reproach.

entries.definition: (used of behavior or attitude) characteristic of those who treat others with condescension
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most accusing word for the same attitude - it makes the condescension something done to someone, and expects the reader to object.

entries.definition: greatest in importance or degree or significance or achievement
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The strongest praise here - greatness set far enough above the rest that comparison stops mattering.

entries.definition: of or characteristic of high rank or importance
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The family's plain baseline - it states high rank or importance and leaves the verdict to the reader, where *eminent* already admires.

entries.definition: of higher rank or status or value
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Technical and relational - it fixes one thing above another in an order and carries neither warmth nor reproach.

entries.definition: at an elevated level in rank or importance
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The most colourless of the three - elevation reduced to a tier, with no suggestion of merit.

entries.definition: superior in rank or accomplishment
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The shortest term here for standing above, registering the position without any of the admiration in *eminent*.
examples: the upper half of the class

entries.definition: used improperly or excessively especially drugs
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Harder than *misused* because excess joins impropriety - the fault lies in how much as well as how, drugs squarely included.

entries.definition: (of persons) taken advantage of
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Cold and calculating beside *ill-used* - it implies someone drew profit from the person, and names the gain rather than the hurt.

entries.definition: (of persons) taken advantage of
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal and plain-spoken - a verdict that a wrong was done, without *exploited*'s implication that anyone gained by it.

entries.definition: used incorrectly or carelessly or for an improper purpose
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flattest of these - it faults the handling, whether careless or deliberate, without yet accusing anyone of cruelty.
examples: misused words are often laughable but one weeps for misused talents

entries.definition: (of persons) taken advantage of
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and the mildest here - imposition rather than injury, and it lets the aggrieved feeling of the person show through.

entries.definition: (of persons) taken advantage of
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Bare and cutting - the unmodified participle reduces the person to an instrument, saying far less than *exploited* and landing colder for it.
examples: after going out of his way to help his friend get the job he felt not appreciated but used

entries.definition: (of persons) taken advantage of
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: British spelling of *victimized*, and it carries the same total verdict - the person defined by the wrong rather than merely subjected to it.

entries.definition: (of persons) taken advantage of
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The strongest of the set - it does not merely report the wrong but makes the person's whole standing consist in having suffered it.

entries.definition: of or providing nourishment
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The stiffer-sounding twin of *alimentary*, carrying the same neutral claim that something supplies nourishment.

entries.definition: of or providing nourishment
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flat and clinical - it states that a thing feeds and stops there, with none of the approval in *nourishing*.

entries.definition: promoting health; healthful
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Informal, and addressed to the eater rather than to the food, which makes the benefit personal in a way *salubrious* never is.

entries.definition: promoting health; healthful
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Plain approval of what a food does for the body, without the moral reach of *wholesome*.
examples: healthy and normal outlets for youthful energy

entries.definition: of foods that are low in fats and sodium and other ingredients that may foster heart disease
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approval pinned to one measurable thing, and to what the food leaves out rather than what it supplies.

entries.definition: providing abundant nourishment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warm approval of abundance - the meal is praised for filling as well as feeding.

entries.definition: of or providing nourishment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warm where *alimentary* is clinical - the food is credited with doing the body good, not merely with feeding it.

entries.definition: of or providing nourishment
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A bare classifier of what a substance supplies, passing no verdict on whether that is welcome.

entries.definition: of or providing nourishment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A quiet recommendation - it praises food for the good it delivers, where *nutrient* only labels it.

entries.definition: of or providing nourishment
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Names the capacity to nourish rather than praising the food that has it - the technical member of the set.

entries.definition: promoting health; healthful
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and slightly grand - the same claim as *healthy* pitched at a height the plainer word never reaches.
examples: the salubrious mountain air and water

entries.definition: providing abundant nourishment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Measures the abundance by its effect on the appetite rather than by the size of the plate.

entries.definition: providing abundant nourishment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Sturdy, unshowy approval - nourishment credited with being dependable rather than generous.

entries.definition: providing abundant nourishment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approval by fair measure - a full and proper portion rather than a lavish one.

entries.definition: providing abundant nourishment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Weighs the meal by sheer bulk, a cooler judgement than *hearty* makes of the same plateful.

entries.definition: conducive to or characteristic of physical or moral well-being
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approval that reaches past the body to character - it can be aimed at a person's morals as readily as at a meal.
